result.source: polynomial-size bounded-fanin majority circuit -> Tseitin 3CNF -> exact PAIR+OR_3 selector compilation

proof_components.affine_hull: full GF(2)^n because 1^n and 1^n xor e_i are all satisfying
proof_components.cnf_lower_bound: every equivalent CNF needs at least binom(n,ceil(n/2)-1) clauses

result.consequence: exact elimination of all initialization auxiliaries cannot stay polynomial in the frozen no-fresh-aux affine+CNF grammar

umbrella_progress_theorem.statement: A uniform exact symbolic process with polynomial initialization, polynomial state size, polynomially many polynomial-cost transitions, exact semantic preservation, and terminal TRUE/FALSE on every PAIR_SELECTOR_HITTING_3 input exists iff PAIR_SELECTOR_HITTING_3 is in deterministic polynomial time.
umbrella_progress_theorem.meaning: an unrestricted progress/terminalization gate is algorithmically equivalent to the original universal solving problem; progress accounting alone does not create a new tractability theorem
umbrella_progress_theorem.implication: because 3SAT <=_lin PAIR_SELECTOR_HITTING_3, a universal PASS would imply SAT in P and P=NP

survivor.warning: fresh auxiliaries can preserve compact encoding while merely renaming unresolved semantics
